Frequently Asked Questions

What are luxury home interior designs for Rajokri farmhouses?

Can you design a home theatre or bar?

Yes. Home theatres, bars, wine rooms, gyms and spa areas can be planned with the right acoustics, lighting and ventilation.

Do you design pool areas and outdoor lounges?

Yes. Pool decks, cabanas and outdoor lounges are designed with the interiors so the property feels like one complete home.

How do luxury home interior designs stay practical for families?

Durable finishes, concealed storage and easy-care fabrics keep the home luxurious and usable for children, guests and pets.
